facts.text: Pantora was the primary moon in orbit around the planet Orto Plutonia, in the Pantora system, located in the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-19 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

evidence.quote: Pantora was the primary moon in orbit around the planet Orto Plutonia, in the Pantora system, located in the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-19 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

facts.text: Pantora was a member of the Galactic Republic and therefore represented in the Galactic Senate.

evidence.quote: Pantora was a member of the Galactic Republic and therefore represented in the Galactic Senate.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Pantora remained loyal to the Republic and Riyo Chuchi served as its senator.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Pantora remained loyal to the Republic and Riyo Chuchi served as its senator.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, a Republic outpost was established on Orto Plutonia at the request of Chairman Chi Cho, who feared that Pantora might be targeted by the Separatists due to its Republic leanings.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, a Republic outpost was established on Orto Plutonia at the request of Chairman Chi Cho, who feared that Pantora might be targeted by the Separatists due to its Republic leanings.

facts.text: The outpost, as well as a droid base that had indeed been established there as well, ran afoul of the Talz and all personnel were wiped out.

evidence.quote: The outpost, as well as a droid base that had indeed been established there as well, ran afoul of the Talz and all personnel were wiped out.

facts.text: This led to the discovery of the Talz by a joint Pantoran-Republic task force sent to investigate the loss of contact, placing Pantora's claim to the planet into question.

evidence.quote: This led to the discovery of the Talz by a joint Pantoran-Republic task force sent to investigate the loss of contact, placing Pantora's claim to the planet into question.

facts.text: Pantora was later blockaded by the Trade Federation, who falsely claimed that the moon owed them outstanding debts but in reality, were hoping to pressure the Pantorans into joining the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

evidence.quote: Pantora was later blockaded by the Trade Federation, who falsely claimed that the moon owed them outstanding debts but in reality, were hoping to pressure the Pantorans into joining the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

facts.text: Pantora was the principal moon of the Outer Rim Territories' Pantora system, orbiting the ice planet Orto Plutonia.

evidence.quote: Pantora was the principal moon of the Outer Rim Territories' Pantora system, orbiting the ice planet Orto Plutonia.

facts.text: Pantora was covered by terrestrial land, with marshes on the outskirts of its cities.

evidence.quote: Pantora was covered by terrestrial land, with marshes on the outskirts of its cities.

facts.text: It was a member of the Galactic Republic and had full senatorial representation on Coruscant.

evidence.quote: It was a member of the Galactic Republic and had full senatorial representation on Coruscant.

facts.text: Beginning as a feudal system of government, Pantora eventually developed a democratically elected government, presided over by the Pantoran Assembly which was in turn led by the Chairman.

evidence.quote: Beginning as a feudal system of government, Pantora eventually developed a democratically elected government, presided over by the Pantoran Assembly which was in turn led by the Chairman.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the manipulative Chi Cho at the time ruled over Pantora as chairman.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the manipulative Chi Cho at the time ruled over Pantora as chairman.

facts.text: The moon was represented in Galactic Senate by the young female Senator Riyo Chuchi.

evidence.quote: The moon was represented in Galactic Senate by the young female Senator Riyo Chuchi.

facts.text: An influential moon, Pantora was able to request and receive a Republic outpost within its system as a measure of protection against the CIS forces during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: An influential moon, Pantora was able to request and receive a Republic outpost within its system as a measure of protection against the CIS forces during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: Initially thought to be the only inhabited world in the system, Pantora orbited the ice world of Orto Plutonia, which was a protectorate of the Pantorans and—unknown to them—a home to a Talz colony.

evidence.quote: Initially thought to be the only inhabited world in the system, Pantora orbited the ice world of Orto Plutonia, which was a protectorate of the Pantorans and—unknown to them—a home to a Talz colony.

facts.text: However, Senator Chuchi intervened at the behest of the Pantoran Assembly and, in respect of the Talz's wishes to be left alone, she recalled the Pantoran and Republic presence from the ice world and returned to Pantora.

evidence.quote: However, Senator Chuchi intervened at the behest of the Pantoran Assembly and, in respect of the Talz's wishes to be left alone, she recalled the Pantoran and Republic presence from the ice world and returned to Pantora.

facts.text: Later in the war, Pantora was blockaded by the Trade Federation under the command of Lott Dod to force Pantora to join the Separatists.

evidence.quote: Later in the war, Pantora was blockaded by the Trade Federation under the command of Lott Dod to force Pantora to join the Separatists.

facts.text: The blockade led to violent riots and calls to join the CIS in desperation.

evidence.quote: The blockade led to violent riots and calls to join the CIS in desperation.

facts.text: Chuchi successfully negotiated with the Trade Federation ambassador to end the blockade and resume trade relations after she threatened to blackmail him and expose his alliance with the Separatists.

evidence.quote: Chuchi successfully negotiated with the Trade Federation ambassador to end the blockade and resume trade relations after she threatened to blackmail him and expose his alliance with the Separatists.

facts.text: When the Republic collapsed and the Galactic Empire seized control of the galaxy, Pantora was cut off from the rest of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: When the Republic collapsed and the Galactic Empire seized control of the galaxy, Pantora was cut off from the rest of the galaxy.

facts.text: The first group believed that integrating with the Empire was the only path to security and economic strength, while the traditionalist Republicans believed the Empire stood in stark opposition to the core principles and values of the Pantoran culture.

evidence.quote: The first group believed that integrating with the Empire was the only path to security and economic strength, while the traditionalist Republicans believed the Empire stood in stark opposition to the core principles and values of the Pantoran culture.

facts.text: Building up a small navy of volunteers, the Assembly cautiously expanded; careful to avoid drawing Imperial attention to their work.

evidence.quote: Building up a small navy of volunteers, the Assembly cautiously expanded; careful to avoid drawing Imperial attention to their work.

facts.text: Pantoran City was the capital city of the moon Pantora. The government of Pantora, the Pantoran Assembly, governed the moon from Pantoran City.

evidence.quote: Pantoran City was the capital city of the moon Pantora. The government of Pantora, the Pantoran Assembly, governed the moon from Pantoran City.

facts.text: Ro Station was a city located on the moon Pantora. During the early days of the Galactic Empire, the outpost's business and industry was struggling despite the end of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: Ro Station was a city located on the moon Pantora. During the early days of the Galactic Empire, the outpost's business and industry was struggling despite the end of the Clone Wars.

facts.text: The Pantora tea parlor was a tea parlor on Pantora used for a secret meeting between Senators Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh during or after 18 BBY. It was infiltrated by CX-1, who tried to assassinate Singh.
entities: Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting

evidence.quote: The Pantora tea parlor was a tea parlor on Pantora used for a secret meeting between Senators Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh during or after 18 BBY. It was infiltrated by CX-1, who tried to assassinate Singh.

facts.text: The southern maintenance tower was a building on Pantora. After attempting to assassinate Avi Singh during or after 18 BBY, the clone assassin CX-1 fled to the tower, but was captured after being stunned several times by members of the Clone Underground.
